x_snc_devtools_technical_debt.description: For unclear reasons, synchronous HTTP requests are prevented for non-admin users in synchronous business rules. This prevents non-admins from "preparing" a deployment. The quick fix is to assign the admin role to x_snc_deployer.manager (which is a temporary solution) - the actual solution is to perform the "Prepare" step as a lengthy operation in the background (with progress bar in the GUI).
